checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: pin modal actions below a scrolling content area so the primary button is reachable without scrolling on phones

impact_assessment.why: At 390x844 the Field Manual dialog is 760px tall, its whole content scrolls, and the primary action sits at y=832 with a 876px bottom; the button is below the fold and the probe reports primaryVisible false. Desktop keeps it visible, so the how-to action only fails on phones.
impact_assessment.benefits: How-to, pause and victory actions stay in view while the body scrolls; the primary button is tappable immediately and the close button stays at the top. Desktop layout keeps the same content and actions.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: modal actions move outside .modal__content and the dialog becomes a flex column when open; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save change; layout: content scrolls instead of the whole dialog, and small screens keep full-width buttons.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Structural UI test, 390x844 and 1440x900 before/after probes with modal/content/action rects, a real tap on the primary action, a content-scroll check that the actions stay fixed, and the 18-level regression.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented: modal actions moved outside the scrolling content, flex-column open dialog, content overflow, pinned action row with rule and solid glass, compact mobile padding, modal-structure test, README and ADR-020

[1/3] Plan: show the next rank and stars remaining under the operator rank

impact_assessment.why: The profile shows the current rank (for example Operator) but not how far the player is from the next one; the thresholds live only in code, so 10 stars and 18 stars look equally complete until the rank name changes.
impact_assessment.benefits: A line under the rank states '9 stars to Weaver' or 'All 54 stars collected', turning the rank into a visible progression target without a new panel or save field.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rank thresholds move into one shared constant; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: derived from statsFor stars; layout: one short mono line under the rank, which already has room.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure rankProgress cases at 0/7/8/44/54/invalid, a shared RANKS table with unchanged rankFor results, a seeded 10-star before/after profile pair, a played First Light rank update, and the 18-level regression.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented: frozen RANKS table shared by rankFor, rankProgress helper with three tests, profile-rank-next line and copy, muted styling, UI cue contract, README and ADR-021

[3/3] Verified: npm test 103/103; aikit check 5/5; seeded 10-star profile reads 9 stars to Weaver, fresh First Light clear reads 5 stars to Operator, before worktree shows no next line; 18/18 levels at par; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan: keep a subtle marker on the last rotated piece so large chambers retain the player's place

impact_assessment.why: After the 280ms is-turning bump ends, nothing on the board records which rotatable was last changed. On a 15-rotatable finale a player who looks away or tries several mirrors has to infer the last move from the beam alone; a probe after a real click finds zero persistent markers.
impact_assessment.benefits: The clicked cell keeps a thin cyan outline until the next rotation or reset, giving a stable visual anchor without changing the beam, scoring or save; the marker is derived from the interaction and costs one class toggle.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds an is-last-moved class; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: cleared on reset/start; layout: a 1px outline in the existing cell gutter, forced-colors mapped to Highlight.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Board before/after crop on The Confluence, a real run that moves the marker from one piece to another and clears it on reset, forced-colors check, and the 18-level regression.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented: is-last-moved class on the clicked rotatable, 320ms is-turning cleanup with per-node timers, reset clears both, cyan cell-gutter outline and forced-colors mapping, README and ADR-022

[3/3] Verified: npm test 103/103; aikit check 5/5; Confluence probe moves marker 2,3 to 4,3 with turning empty after 450ms and clears on reset; board crops show the outline; 18/18 levels at par; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan: make the title action read Replay the relay after all 18 chambers, without changing its first-uncleared-chamber behavior

impact_assessment.why: A played 54-star save still shows 'Enter the relay' and clicking it starts First Light; the label describes a first entry while the action is a replay, so the primary endgame action lies about what it does.
impact_assessment.benefits: The title action states the real endgame state: Enter the relay before 18/18, Replay the relay after; clicked behavior stays First Light after a full clear, so only the copy changes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds a start-label span and a pure CTA helper; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: reads statsFor completion, no save change; layout: the label length grows by three characters but stays within the primary button.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure relayCtaLabel cases at 0/17/18/19 with a zero-total guard, a DOM label-span contract, a played 18/18 before/after title pair, a click check that still opens First Light, and the 18-level regression.

[1/3] Plan: duck the ambient music under the victory fanfare and restore it afterward

impact_assessment.why: The victory fanfare plays four tones at gains 0.035-0.04 while the ambient pad stays at 0.05; the fanfare competes with the music it should sit above. The audio module has musicGain state but no duck path and no test coverage for one.
impact_assessment.benefits: The fanfare gets headroom without changing the music/effects toggles or adding assets; the pad returns to its normal level after 1.4s, and the duck is a no-op when music or effects are off.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: playVictory gains a guard and duck call, audio exports a musicLevel probe; dependency: none; concurrency: one gain automation per victory, canceled/rescheduled at the current value; state: no save change; audio only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: A no-context duck/musicLevel test, real Double Down play with a gain-node probe that tracks the 0.05 pad before victory and reads it at 200ms/1.7s after, and the 18-level regression.
